title: Demonstrations at German airports against migrant deportations

tea.why: People are protesting against the deportation of rejected asylum seekers, their pre-removal detention, and removal infrastructure.
tea.want: Demonstrators demand an immediate halt to deportations and the redirection of funds toward migrant social integration programs.
tea.changed: Oct 25, 2026: Hundreds of protesters gathered at multiple German airports, with over 700 demonstrators demonstrating near Munich Airport.

summary: On Saturday, October 25, 2026, hundreds of people participated in demonstrations at major airports across Germany to protest the deportation of rejected asylum seekers, pre-removal detention, and the expansion of deportation infrastructure. According to police estimates, more than 700 demonstrators gathered near Munich Airport, with other rallies occurring at airports in Leipzig/Halle, Frankfurt, Berlin Brandenburg, Cologne/Bonn, and Düsseldorf, as well as cities like Bielefeld and Hanover. The organising alliance placed the total nationwide turnout significantly higher at several thousand participants. Organisers criticised the federal government's cooperation with Afghanistan's rulers to facilitate deportations. Meanwhile, German authorities stated that most individuals deported to Afghanistan had criminal convictions.
demands: Investment in migrant social integration instead of removal infrastructure
response: German authorities stated that most individuals deported to Afghanistan had been convicted of criminal offences, according to reporting by ProtoThema and Gazeta Express.

crowd.text: More than 700 demonstrators took part in the protest near Munich Airport, according to police estimates.

updates.text: Demonstrations took place at multiple German airports, drawing hundreds of participants according to police estimates.
